about: The wild island's visual check (docs/ark/wild-island.md): its own page (src/ark-scene/islands/wild/entry.ts) on SwiftShader, the clock frozen per shot (ARK_TIME 120, the shot's hour), without the photographed sky; the asset library's models are awaited before the first shot. Run: npx tsx scripts/ark-wild.mts visual [--update]. Same measures and default limits as the Ark's visual CI (runtime/visual-compare.ts).
